strategy_roster.name: Color Zerolag RVI
strategy_roster.notes: RVI is not in the DSL, so a zero-lag EMA-difference stand-in uses the documented RviLength 14 and SignalLength 9 SMA as its signal line; the documented contrarian long (main line crossing below the signal) and the opposite cross as exit are preserved. The 4-hour candle type and Buy/Sell toggles are not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: Since CMO equals 2*RSI-100, the documented LowerThreshold -50 and UpperThreshold 50 at CmoPeriod 9 map exactly onto RSI(9) below 25 and above 75. The MaxBarsInPosition = 5 time exit has no DSL equivalent and the 1-minute candle type is not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Template M5 Envelopes
strategy_roster.notes: The LWMA envelope is approximated by SMA(20) with a stated 1% EnvelopeDeviation (no period or deviation is documented), and the long setup reduces to price sitting below the lower envelope, exiting back at the envelope basis. Point-based DistancePoints, EntryOffset, slippage, spread filter, stop/target and the pending-order repricing logic are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Is Your Friend
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) < 0 and ema(close,8) > sma(close,20) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: The bearish-then-stronger-bullish pair becomes a bullish bar after a down close (shifted opens are unavailable), confirmed by the documented Fast MA 8 / Slow MA 20 alignment (LWMA approximated by SMA) and a MACD filter evaluated on the traded series instead of monthly. The 20/50-pip stop and target, break-even lock and trailing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Sail System EA
strategy_roster.notes: A hedging scalper that keeps symmetrical long and short PositionState objects, re-arms both sides and manages virtual stops, spread and broker level constraints; it needs simultaneous opposing positions. The long-only engine cannot represent it, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: ROA Effect Stocks
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is a cross-sectional ranking by externally supplied return-on-assets with monthly rebalancing into the top decile, which depends on fundamental data and many symbols at once. No single-symbol price series can express it, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Calculation Position Size Based on Risk
strategy_roster.notes: This is a position-sizing demonstration whose entries are explicitly not market-derived (random, every 333rd/444th bar) and whose only exit is the documented 10% stop. The 2% account risk value is a sizing input, not a price condition, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: AFL Winner V2
strategy_roster.notes: The AFL Winner indicator is only described as stochastic-based with no parameter values, so RSI(9) (KPeriod as the length) stands in with HighLevel 70 for bullish and LowLevel 30 for bearish signals as stated defaults. The custom indicator, %D smoothing and relative-position nuance are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Asset Growth Effect
strategy_roster.notes: Long the lowest and short the highest asset-growth quantile using reported filing fundamentals, rebalanced annually across the universe. That cross-sectional fundamental signal is unavailable in a single-symbol OHLCV backtest, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Bot for Spot Market - Custom Grid
strategy_roster.notes: A grid engine: it buys at start, adds orders every 0.5% drop below the last entry and closes everything only when price exceeds the average entry by 2%. Average-entry arithmetic and staggered orders cannot be expressed, so the never-true guard is used.
